sentences.text: Researchers developed a new family of zwitterionic solvents, molecules with both positive and negative charges, designed to replace dimethyl sulfoxide in biological experiments.

These solvents exhibited no oral toxicity and lower intravenous toxicity than a previously reported solvent, while enabling the delivery of drugs that could not be dissolved in water or dimethyl sulfoxide.
Substituting dimethyl sulfoxide with the new solvents reduced the unwanted activation of c-fos genes, a marker of neuronal activity, thereby aiding brain studies.
The authors suggest this solvent family could help develop 1000 to 5000 new drugs by making previously unusable drug candidates soluble.
